world.notes: Pulled with the facebook-ads MCP tool ads_get_ad_entities, level=adset, 5 calls, all with time_range {"since":"2026-09-08","until":"2026-09-14"} (explicit dates, no preset), filtering adset.amount_spent GREATER_THAN 0, sort=amount_spent_descending, limit=50, include_additional_context=false; paged with the returned pagination.next_cursor and every other parameter resent unchanged. Pages returned 50/50/50/50/18 = 218 ad sets; the 5th page had no next_cursor, so that is the complete set. All ad set ids are unique. Field names were verified first with ads_get_field_context: inline_link_clicks does NOT exist -- the canonical field is link_click (aliases link_clicks, actions:link_click); landing page views is omni_landing_page_view; app installs are mobile_app_install and omni_app_install; purchases is omni_purchase. start_trial / mobile_app_trial / trials_started are all unknown_fields, so counts.trials is null for every pool -- the tool exposes no trial metric. COUNT: 218 ad sets with spend > 0 -- far above the 60-120 the brief expected, because the account runs many small daily-rebuilt CPI-CREATOR and CPT-TEST ad sets; the tail is tiny (115 ad sets under $100, 20 under $5). DOORS (by results indicator): CPT 122 (conversions:app_custom_event.purchase_completed), CPI 95 (actions:mobile_app_install), WEB 1 (actions:offsite_conversion.fb_pixel_lead -- one ad set, 'ad set 3 - 6 new creatives' in 'BC Creators campaign 1 - 30 July 2026', destination_type UNDEFINED, promoted_object custom_event_type LEAD with a real pixel_id 1076375544915405, cost_per_result labelled 'Clienti potentiali pe site-ul web'; it is a website-lead ad set sitting in this app account, not an app pool). ATTRIBUTION IS NOT UNIFORM: 99 ad sets read 7d_click, 118 read 1d_click, 1 reads 1d_view_7d_click_1d_ev (the WEB one). The 1d_click pools are the Android SCALE/CPI-CREATOR/CPI-IMG and PH-Android sets. Every results value is tagged attribution_windows ["default"], i.e. each ad set's own setting; no per-window breakdown was requested or returned. So world.attribution_window is 'mixed' and the real window is on each pool as attribution_setting. ANDROID: roughly 152 of the 218 ad sets are Android (names/campaigns say ANDROID), including the whole CPI-CREATOR / CPI-IMG test program and the SCALE - auto family. iOS and Android sit side by side in this one account. NULLS: app_installs null on 7 ad sets, results null on 10, purchases null on 158, landing_page_views null on 30. results null means the tool returned results.value = "Not available" (Meta suppressing a tiny count) -- those 10 ad sets are 120247090831800160, 120247145941470160, 120247090835900160, 120247058141170160, 120247160312640160, 120247160331010160, 120247159507200160, 120247159577910160, 120247159187990160, 120247159193220160. Per the README, null = not read, NOT a verified zero. PURCHASES: omni_purchase comes back null on every Android ad set and on every CPI ad set -- Meta does not report a generic purchase for them here -- so counts.purchases is mostly null and its total is not comparable to counts.results. RESULTS != PURCHASES: on CPT pools results counts the app custom event purchase_completed (cost_per_result label '(purchase_completed)'), which is NOT Meta's generic omni_purchase; both are recorded separately. OPTIMIZATION: every CPT pool has optimization_goal OFFSITE_CONVERSIONS with promoted_object {pixel_id: null, custom_event_type: "OTHER", pixel_rule: null} -- the event is not named in promoted_object, so optimization_event is taken from the results indicator / cost_per_result label. CPI pools have optimization_goal APP_INSTALLS and a fully null promoted_object. ODD: omni_landing_page_view is tiny next to link_clicks on every app pool (e.g. 433 LPV vs 17,231 link clicks on the top ad set) -- for an app-store destination LPV is not a real funnel step, treat it as noise. The one exception is the WEB ad set, where LPV 2,208 against 3,139 link clicks behaves like a real web funnel. DRIFT vs the reference reading: ad set 120246661279120160 now reads spend 13552.42 / impressions 888901 against 13552.35 / 888895 in the single-ad-set reading taken earlier the same day (2026-09-15T14:09:55Z). Meta is still settling the window; everything else on that pool matches exactly. Read-only pull; nothing was created, updated, activated or paused. No per-ad rows were pulled this time.
